item.title: A turf war over parking enforcement bursts into public view
item.description: A turf war over parking enforcement bursts into public view The finance department has faced stiff resistance to its plan to take over parking enforcement — and have OPD recover abandoned vehicles. Officials presented their plan at a city council committee meeting on Tuesday.

item.description: A mobile clinic for sex-trafficked youth opens in Oakland Offering STI testing, birth control, and other reproductive health services to young people being trafficked on “the Blade,” the clinic aims to meet people where they are.
